answer: The lantern index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 412 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pigment. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the marble queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. That is 26 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
